methods.summary: Run up to 10 public reads in one round trip (`POST /v1/batch`).
methods.description:
Run up to 10 public reads in one round trip (`POST /v1/batch`).

Each item is authorized on its own; the client's bearer token applies to
every item. Results come back in order as `{ path, status, body }`. Only
paths under `/v1/index/`, `/v1/subgraphs`, `/v1/streams/`, and
`/v1/contracts` are allowed; anything else is a per-item 400.

params.name: requests
params.type: { path: string; params?: Record<string, string | number | boolean> }[]

returns.type: Promise<{ results: { path: string | null; status: number; body: unknown }[] }>

methods.summary: Get a one-call snapshot of your account and instance.
methods.description:
Get a one-call snapshot of your account and instance.

Returns a [`ContextSnapshot`](/docs/sdk-reference/client#t-ContextSnapshot): the same orientation an MCP agent reads
from `secondlayer://context`, available to any SDK or CLI consumer. Reads
run concurrently; a failed read lands as `{ value: null, error }` on its
field rather than rejecting the whole snapshot.

types.name: ContextField
types.summary: One snapshot field: the value, or `null` plus the error that produced it.

types.name: ContextFieldError
types.summary: Why one snapshot field could not be read.

fields.name: code
fields.description:
Stable code from the API envelope (`UNAUTHORIZED`, `INDEX_NOT_READY`)
or the SDK (`REQUEST_TIMEOUT`); absent for a bare transport failure.

fields.name: status
fields.description: HTTP status; `0` when the API could not be reached.

fields.name: retryable
fields.description: Whether the same read can succeed on a retry (429, 5xx, network).

types.name: ContextSnapshot
types.summary: A point-in-time orientation snapshot for an agent: the live tips and what this instance holds.

fields.name: webhooks
fields.type: ContextField<{ count: number; byStatus: Record<string, number> }>

fields.name: finalized_height
fields.description:
Highest height treated as immutable (past the burn-confirmation
finality boundary). Rows at or below it never reorg — `finalizedOnly`
consumers gate on this, since Index rows carry no per-event flag.

fields.name: overall
fields.description: The API's own top-level verdict, passed through unmodified.

fields.name: title
fields.description: What is wrong, in one line.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: Why — assembled only from what the payload actually reports.

fields.name: nextSteps
fields.description: What to run next, most useful first.

fields.name: finalized_height
fields.description:
Highest Stacks block past the burn-confirmation finality boundary.
Optional for back-compat; the API always sets it.

fields.name: oldest_seekable_height
fields.description:
Oldest height still seekable on the live API for the caller's tier
(`tip - retention`). `null` = unlimited retention. Older reads must use the
cold dumps lane. Optional for back-compat.

fields.name: integrity
fields.description: history_filling = expected gaps while a tip-first backfill op runs.

fields.name: lastError
fields.description: Most recent indexing error reason + when it occurred, if any.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Last row mutation timestamp; powers per-card freshness.
